title: Обычный день · independent QA acceptance for S02–S03

assertions: The tracked loaf has one owner at every sampled frame.
Raw loaf leaves the crate before becoming visible in hands.
Packed loaf persists from S02 into S03.
Trolley releases the loaf before the shelf receives it.
Vova never holds the phone while carrying the loaf.
Board marks appear only after the held chalk contacts the board.
The completed arithmetic persists throughout the next scene.
Nastya never holds a phone during an active lesson.
The walk to a pupil follows the aisle around desks.

persistence: Intermediate ownership and chalk/chat state survive roundtrip through validated save data.
Malformed JSON, mismatched version, negative/non-finite/overrun time and unsupported preferences are rejected or normalized safely.
Storage quota and unavailable-storage errors never terminate the simulation.
controls: Playback speed changes wall-clock rate without changing event order.
A long tab suspension cannot jump through a physical action.
Fast-forward advances continuously and observes every ownership boundary.
Reduced motion does not remove ownership or dialogue events.
evidenceLimitations: Native Canvas captures exercise the game's exported renderFrame, not a browser.
DOM layout, real mobile touch, actual browser audio, focus/PIP and browser performance are NOT_CHECKED.
Deterministic regression results do not certify art quality or complete-game readiness.
